novelty_preflight.disposition: distinct edge-conditioned lexicalization state; no promotion to reader evidence

method: Each frame is a directed semantic edge between two events. Left and right role slots use independent authored lexical pools. An exhaustive boundary-synchronous ledger chooses whole lexical words from opposite edges and emits one matching character pair per transition; no static palindrome text is imported.

config.search_control: deterministic exhaustive recursion; no beam, MCTS, chart, CSP, ILP, or catalogue input
